dtsPropsFor.DocsMobileNavigation: /** Docs href of the current page, e.g. "/docs/querying"; that link renders active. */ activeHref: string; /** Site hostname used to build absolute docs links, e.g. "query.host". */ hostname: string; /** Extra links shown under the Reference section on API reference pages. */ reference?: { label: string; items: readonly { href: string; label: string }[] };
dtsPropsFor.QueryResult: /** Browser-safe game registry entries; used to show the game name. */ games: readonly { id: string; name: string; defaultMode: "summary" | "full"; defaultPort?: number; defaultQueryPort?: number; queryPortStrategy?: "offset" | "fixed"; capabilities: Record<string, "supported" | "conditional" | "unsupported"> }[]; /** The hosted response body exactly as received; shown on the JSON tab. */ raw: string; /** Parsed hosted query response: success (ok: true) or failure (ok: false). */ result: ({ ok: true; game: string; durationMs: number; sources: readonly { source: string; status: "ok" | "timeout" | "blocked" | "malformed" | "unsupported" | "not-requested" | "failed"; rttMs?: number }[]; warnings: readonly { code: string; message: string; source?: string }[]; cache: { status: "coalesced" | "hit" | "miss"; ageMs: number; ttlMs: number }; partial: boolean; server: { name?: string; map?: string; version?: string; password?: boolean; players?: { online?: number; max?: number }; queryRttMs?: number }; data: Record<string, unknown>; rawData?: Record<string, unknown> }) | ({ ok: false; game: string; durationMs: number; sources: readonly { source: string; status: "ok" | "timeout" | "blocked" | "malformed" | "unsupported" | "not-requested" | "failed"; rttMs?: number }[]; warnings: readonly { code: string; message: string; source?: string }[]; cache: { status: "coalesced" | "hit" | "miss"; ageMs: number; ttlMs: number }; error: { code: "ABORTED" | "CONNECTION_FAILED" | "DNS_FAILED" | "INTERNAL_ERROR" | "INVALID_INPUT" | "MALFORMED_RESPONSE" | "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE" | "TARGET_BLOCKED" | "TIMEOUT"; message: string; source?: string } });
dtsPropsFor.QueryPlayground: /** Browser-safe game registry entries offered in the game picker. */ games: readonly { id: string; name: string; defaultMode: "summary" | "full"; defaultPort?: number; defaultQueryPort?: number; queryPortStrategy?: "offset" | "fixed"; capabilities: Record<string, "supported" | "conditional" | "unsupported"> }[]; /** Request query string (e.g. "?game=minecraft&host=play.example.com") so shared links render prefilled. */ search: string;
dtsPropsFor.CustomSelect: /** Optional help text under the control. */ help?: string; id: string; label: string; /** Name of the hidden native select submitted with the form. */ name: string; onChange: (value: string) => void; options: readonly { label: string; value: string }[]; required?: boolean; value: string;
